newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Datacraft wins US$1.6 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Datacraft wins US$1.6 mln contract.

text.p: Communications and systems integrator Datacraft Asia Ltd said on Thursday it had won a US$1.6 million contract to set up the largest voice and data network in India.

It said in a statement the contract was awarded by ANZ Grindlays bank India for a bank communications project and secured by Datacraft RPG, a joint venture between Datacraft Asia and RPG Enterprises in India. The project involves connecting 57 of the bank's branches throughout India.
Datacraft shares ended up US$0.22 at US$3.38 on Thursday.
